area-three-crossings.alt: The cubic f(x) = x³ − 3x and the line g(x) = x cross at (−2, −2), (0, 0) and (2, 2). From −2 to 0 the cubic is on top (pink piece, rectangle height f − g); from 0 to 2 the line is on top (blue piece, rectangle height g − f). The side panel adds the pieces, 4 + 4 = 8, and warns that one integral of f − g from −2 to 2 is 0 because the pieces cancel.
